tests.procedure: Identification by HPLC: apply the chromatographic conditions of the assay; the retention time of the principal peaks in the test chromatogram must correspond to those of the standard chromatograms (vitamin B6 and folic acid).

details.reference: HPLC Analytical Method Validation for Folic acid & Pyridoxine hydrochloride in Feroglobin B12 Capsules (C5R-54-513)

tests.source: Feroglobin Granules__SM- Feroglobin B12 granules after edit.txt:31

tests.procedure: Identification by AAS: the assay preparation prepared as directed in the assay for iron, zinc or copper exhibits an absorption maximum at the same wavelength as that of the corresponding standard (248.3 nm for Fe, 213.9 nm for Zn, 324.8 nm for Cu).
tests.source: Feroglobin Granules__SM- Feroglobin B12 granules after edit.txt:31

tests.procedure: Assay of vitamin B6 (pyridoxine HCl) and folic acid by HPLC: standards 60 mg pyridoxine HCl and 75 mg folic acid working standard in 100 mL each with 5 mL 1 N NaOH, sonicate, make to volume with purified water; working standard = 5 mL pyridoxine stock + 1 mL folic acid stock to 100 mL. Sample: about 697.95 mg sample in 100 mL with 5 mL 1 N NaOH, sonicate 15 min, filter. Mobile phase 87% hexanesulphonic solution : 13% HPLC methanol; C18 BDS column 25 cm, 35 °C; 20 µL; 1.5 mL/min; UV 280 nm. Suitability: 6 replicate standard injections, RSD NMT 2%. Assay % = (PAt / PAst) x (Act.Wt std / Theo.Wt std) x (Theo.Wt test / Act.Wt test) x Potency. Limit 90.0% to 150.0% of labeled amount.

details.workingStandard: 5 mL pyridoxine stock + 1 mL folic acid stock to 100 mL amber flask
details.formula: Assay % = (PAt/PAst) x (Act.Wt std / Theo.Wt std) x (Theo.Wt test / Act.Wt test) x Potency

tests.source: Feroglobin Granules__SM- Feroglobin B12 granules after edit.txt:32

tests.procedure: Iron by AAS: stock 2 mL of 1000 mg/L iron standard to 100 mL; working standards 2.0, 4.0 and 6.0 mg/L (10, 20, 30 mL of stock to 100 mL); sample 10 mL of sample stock to 100 mL, then 10 mL to 50 mL (expected 4.8 mg/L). Hollow cathode Fe, 248.3 nm, slit 0.5 nm, air-acetylene; calibration curve, purified water blank. Assay % = (sample conc. by AAS x theoretical weight 465.3 mg x 100) / (expected conc. x actual weight).

details.formula: Assay % = (sample conc. by AAS x Th.Wt x 100) / (expected conc. x Act.Wt)

tests.source: Feroglobin Granules__SM- Feroglobin B12 granules after edit.txt:34

tests.procedure: Zinc by AAS: stock 2 mL of 1000 mg/L zinc standard to 100 mL; working standards 2.0, 4.0 and 6.0 mg/L; sample 10 mL of sample stock to 100 mL, then 20 mL to 50 mL (expected 4.0 mg/L). Hollow cathode Zn, 213.9 nm, slit 0.5 nm, air-acetylene; calibration curve, purified water blank. Assay % = (sample conc. by AAS x theoretical weight 465.3 mg x 100) / (expected conc. x actual weight).

details.formula: Assay % = (sample conc. by AAS x Th.Wt x 100) / (expected conc. x Act.Wt)

Assay % = (sample conc. by AAS x theoretical weight 465.3 mg x 100) / (expected conc. x actual weight).
